title: Tribulnation SDK gateway protocol
description: WebSocket subprotocol tribulnation-gateway.v2: one JSON object per binary frame. Generated by tribulnation.sdk.gateway.codec.protocol_schema; see docs/gateway-protocol.md.

LeverageReq.title: LeverageReq
LeverageReq.description: Fetch the leverage the account can open at on a perpetual market.

CandlesReq.title: CandlesReq
CandlesReq.description: Fetch candles in a half-open time window.

ExchangeReq.title: ExchangeReq
ExchangeReq.description: Resolve an exchange's actual product type, including qualified IDs.

TickersReq.title: TickersReq
TickersReq.description: Fetch bulk tickers from an exchange.

ExchangeCollateralReq.title: ExchangeCollateralReq
ExchangeCollateralReq.description: Fetch a perpetual exchange's pool, as generic collateral.

BalanceReq.title: BalanceReq
BalanceReq.description: Fetch one asset's balance on a spot exchange.

BalancesReq.title: BalancesReq
BalancesReq.description: Fetch a spot market's base and quote balances.

CollateralIdReq.title: CollateralIdReq
CollateralIdReq.description: Fetch the collateral ID funding new orders on a margin market.

OpenOrdersReq.title: OpenOrdersReq
OpenOrdersReq.description: List the account's open orders on a market.

QueryOrderReq.title: QueryOrderReq
QueryOrderReq.description: Look up one order by its venue order ID.

TradesHistoryReq.title: TradesHistoryReq
TradesHistoryReq.description: Fetch the account's fills in a time window.

PositionReq.title: PositionReq
PositionReq.description: Fetch the account's spot position on a market.

AvailableNotionalReq.title: AvailableNotionalReq
AvailableNotionalReq.description: Fetch the notional the account can still open on a market.

WireOrderShape.title: WireOrderShape
WireOrderShape.description: Order as it crosses the wire: prices and quantities decode as `Decimal`.

CancelOrderReq.title: CancelOrderReq
CancelOrderReq.description: Cancel one order by its venue order ID.

CancelOpenOrdersReq.title: CancelOpenOrdersReq
CancelOpenOrdersReq.description: Cancel every open order of the account on a market.

IndexReq.title: IndexReq
IndexReq.description: Fetch a perpetual market's index price.

NextFundingReq.title: NextFundingReq
NextFundingReq.description: Fetch a perpetual market's upcoming funding rate.

FundingRatesReq.title: FundingRatesReq
FundingRatesReq.description: Fetch a perpetual market's historical funding rates.

FundingPaymentsReq.title: FundingPaymentsReq
FundingPaymentsReq.description: Fetch the account's funding payments in a time window.

PerpPositionReq.title: PerpPositionReq
PerpPositionReq.description: Fetch the account's perpetual position on a market.

CollateralReq.title: CollateralReq
CollateralReq.description: Fetch the margin bucket backing a margin market.

PerpCollateralReq.title: PerpCollateralReq
PerpCollateralReq.description: Fetch the perpetual margin bucket backing a market.

ExchangePerpCollateralReq.title: ExchangePerpCollateralReq
ExchangePerpCollateralReq.description: Fetch a perpetual exchange's margin bucket.

VenueReq.title: VenueReq
VenueReq.description: Resolve the venue behind an account key.

DepthStreamReq.title: DepthStreamReq
DepthStreamReq.description: Subscribe to order book updates; items arrive as `depth_data`.

TradesStreamReq.title: TradesStreamReq
TradesStreamReq.description: Subscribe to the account's fills; items arrive as `trades_data`.

UnsubMsg.title: UnsubMsg
UnsubMsg.description: Cancel the stream opened by the request with this `id`.

Fees.title: Fees
Fees.description:
Combined rates as fractions of notional, excluding optional payment discounts.

  Includes applicable side, tax, special and market adjustments. Negative rates
  are rebates. These are current rates, not a guarantee about a future fill or
  fee-asset rounding/conversion. Unknown schedules are not representable here.

LeverageResp.title: LeverageResp
LeverageResp.description: Account leverage on a perpetual market.

CandlesResp.title: CandlesResp
CandlesResp.description: Historical candles, preserving the SDK's value types.

Candle.title: Candle
Candle.description: One trade candle. Mark- and index-price candles are a different series.

ExchangeResp.title: ExchangeResp
ExchangeResp.description: Resolved exchange product type and venue.

TickersResp.title: TickersResp
TickersResp.description: Tickers keyed by native market ID.

Ticker.title: Ticker
Ticker.description:
A market's top-of-book and last-trade snapshot.

  Deliberately excludes 24h open/high/low/change: they are derivable from a
  sampled series, and storing them freezes the venue's windowing choices.

PerpStatsResp.title: PerpStatsResp
PerpStatsResp.description: Perpetual statistics keyed by native market ID.

PerpStats.title: PerpStats
PerpStats.description: A perpetual market's pricing and funding snapshot.

RulesResp.title: RulesResp
RulesResp.description: Market trading rules: a spot market's also name its `base` and `quote`.

OpenOrdersResp.title: OpenOrdersResp
OpenOrdersResp.description: Open orders of the account on a market.

QueryOrderResp.title: QueryOrderResp
QueryOrderResp.description: The order, or null when the venue does not know it.

TradesHistoryResp.title: TradesHistoryResp
TradesHistoryResp.description: Fills of the account in the requested window.

AvailableNotionalResp.title: AvailableNotionalResp
AvailableNotionalResp.description: Notional the account can still open.

OrderResponse.title: OrderResponse
OrderResponse.description: The venue's answer to a placed order.

CollateralResp.title: CollateralResp
CollateralResp.description: Collateral bucket: perpetual margin fields are present when the bucket has them.

PerpCollateral.title: PerpCollateral
PerpCollateral.description: Perpetual collateral of an account bucket.

Balance.title: Balance
Balance.description: One spot asset's balance, in that asset's units.

BalancesResp.title: BalancesResp
BalancesResp.description: A spot market's base and quote balances.

SpotBalances.title: SpotBalances
SpotBalances.description: The balances of a spot pair's two assets.

CollateralIdResp.title: CollateralIdResp
CollateralIdResp.description: The collateral ID funding new orders on a margin market.

ExchangeDescription.title: ExchangeDescription
ExchangeDescription.description: One SDK exchange/product family, identified within its owning venue.

VenuesResp.title: VenuesResp
VenuesResp.description: Account keys configured on the gateway.

DepthDataMsg.title: DepthDataMsg
DepthDataMsg.description: One order book update of a `depth_stream` subscription.

ErrMsg.title: ErrMsg
ErrMsg.description: A call failed; `exc` names the SDK exception class when known.

EndMsg.title: EndMsg
EndMsg.description: A stream ended: cleanly when `error` is null, else with that error.

Collateral.title: Collateral
Collateral.description: The money behind a collateral ID: a spot asset balance or a margin pool.

SpotRules.title: SpotRules
SpotRules.description:
Spot rules, which also name the pair's assets (ADR 0051).

  Perpetual rules do not: a contract's denomination need not be its collateral.

Rules.title: Rules
Rules.description: Trading constraints; canonical asset identities belong to the Catalogue.
